stories.title: Half of Connah’s Quay power station was out on the night Britain ran short of electricity
stories.summary: Half of Connah’s Quay power station was out of action on the night whistleblowers claimed Britain’s electricity grid was not being run securely during June’s heatwave. stories.summary: Police have released a CCTV image of a person they want to identify following an incident at the Quay Shopping Centre in Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Clogau poppy pins on sale at Broughton store to raise money for Army Benevolent Fund
stories.summary: Limited-edition poppy pins raising money for the Army Benevolent Fund are going on sale at Clogau’s Broughton store ahead of Remembrance Sunday. The Bodelwyddan-based jewellery company, known for using Welsh gold, has produced 10,000 pins for 2026, the third year of the campaign. stories.title: Road closures in Connah’s Quay, Flint and Cilcain among this week’s Flintshire roadworks
stories.summary: Golftyn Lane in Connah’s Quay is among the roads closed in Flintshire this week, with more than 25 sets of roadworks listed across the county. The list, from Flintshire County Council’s roadworks bulletin for the week ending Friday, 23 October, includes closures, temporary traffic lights and stop-go boards.
